english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is useful or designed for practical use rather than mainly decorative.
This is the all-purpose choice for something practical and functional rather than merely decorative.
Use this for knowledge that is usable in practice or something practical for real-world use.
Use this for an object, skill, or idea that is useful and can be put to practical use.
Use this for clothes or other things chosen for usefulness and practicality rather than style.
